art.title: POV: your first sushi counter in Japan

gags: freeze snap inside a moving clip (chef + customers freeze staring at the wasabi being stirred, steam and lantern keep moving)
WRONG WAY / RIGHT WAY verdict stamps (overlays on moving footage)
silence-to-shout (chef, male voice: わさびはもう入ってるんだ！ / The wasabi's already in there!)
the wait (chef shapes the next piece, customers eat, steam drifts)
pdca.hook: You stir wasabi into the soy sauce. The chef freezes.
